The [[SH1900]] ''(Remington '''Sh'''otgun Model '''1900''')'' is a [[Light]] class sawed-off double barrel [[:Category:Shotgun|shotgun]] designed to assassinate opponents from close up with high burst damage.

==Usage==
The SH1900 can be selected as the [[Weapons|weapon]] of any [[Light]] build loadout.

The trigger can be pulled to fire a spread of pellets that each deal a small amount of damage to opponents. The trigger must be released before firing again. The weapon does not deal additional damage on headshots. Aiming down sights does not increase the SH1900's accuracy, but the weapon remains accurate when moving and going airborne. 

Due to its high pellet dispersion, the SH1900 will deal more damage based on how close the user is to their target.

The weapon automatically reloads when both shots are fired, or the user can do a tactical reload after firing one shot. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.

===Properties ===
==== Weapon ====
{{Feature icon|Ranged}} Strikes targets by aiming and firing at them from a distance.

{{Feature icon|Single Fire}} Fires once when the trigger is pulled. The trigger must be released before firing again.

{{Feature icon|Multi-Shot}} Releases multiple rounds at the same time with each shot, each dealing minor damage.

{{Feature icon|Stable Accuracy}} Keeps a stable accuracy (pellet spread), even while moving and going airborne. 

{{Feature icon|Full Reload}} Replaces the entire magazine in one animation on reload.

{{Feature icon|Aim Down Sights|negative=true}} Has iron sights, but using them does not affect accuracy (pellet spread).

==== Bullet ====
{{Feature icon|Hitscan}} Travels in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction will deviate from the crosshairs depending on accuracy.

{{Feature icon|Minor Structure Damage}} Damages structures. Takes a very long time to break a concrete wall.

{{Feature icon|Critical Hit|negative=true}} Does not critically hit for increased damage, even if the target was struck on the head. 

== Guide==
=== Strengths ===
*The SH1900's accuracy is mostly unaffected by moving, and does not need to aim down sights to attain maximum accuracy. This makes it possible to strafe around an opponent while hip-firing at them, all while maintaining high accuracy.
*The SH1900 deals extreme damage when up close to its target.
**A [[Light]] contestant can be eliminated with a single shot.
** A [[Medium]] contestant can be eliminated with two shots to the body, and this is possible on even the [[Heavy]] provided that nearly all of the pellets connect.

=== Weaknesses ===
*The SH1900's small magazine size makes missing a shot very punishing.
* High pellet dispersion means that enemies that are not close to the user will not take much damage from a shot.

=== Tactics ===
*An SH1900 user will need to approach opponents from an unexpected angle to be able to deliver the maximum amount of damage.
**The [[Cloaking Device]] or [[Vanishing Bomb]] can help with sneaking around.
**The [[Evasive Dash]] can be used to close the gap and to escape.

[[File:Sh1900_10m.png|thumb|right|300px|<center>10m Spread pattern</center>]]

=== Hitscan ===
*For each pellet in a shot fired by the weapon, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs for each pellet. Since the shotgun has a fixed low accuracy, the random deviation of the pellets causes them to spread out into a fan.

*Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan of each pellet will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired.

{{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the SH1900|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the SH1900|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the SH1900|xp4=20}}
{{EquipmentCosmetics}}

==Trivia== 
*The SH1900 was formerly (pre-[[Pre-Release#Closed Beta 2|CB2]]) named the Sawed-off Shotgun.
*The SH1900 exists in real life as the [https://www.remarms.com/firearm-history/model-1900 Model 1900], introduced in 1900 by [[Wikipedia:Remington_Arms|Remington Arms]], a now-defunct firearms and ammunition manufacturer based in North Carolina, United States. The Model 1900 was a lower priced version of the Model 1894, which was Remington's first hammerless double barrel shotgun.
** "SH" most likely stands for "Shotgun", and 1900 is the year of introduction.
** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]].

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===
* The V9S has a quick reloading animation. Paired with a fairly large magazine for a Light class gun, this allows a V9S user to have very little downtime.

=== Weaknesses ===
* The V9S' damage drop-off may force its user to close the gap in longer-range encounters.

=== Tactics ===
* Firing should always be done while aiming down sights, unless the target is extremely close. Doing so greatly increases the accuracy of the V9S.
* A V9S user should attempt to step in and out of combat to safely be able to deal damage, approaching opponents from unexpected angles so that they cannot retaliate. The moments of cover also serve to reload the weapon.
* This makes the V9S well-suited with the [[Cloaking Device]] or [[Vanishing Bomb]], which can make retreating and flanking easier to execute.

=== Hitscan ===
*When the weapon fires a shot, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs, depending on the accuracy level at the time of firing. 

*Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired.

{{EquipmentCosmetics}}

== Trivia ==
* The V9S exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:Laugo_Alien|Laugo Arms Alien]], produced by Laugo Arms, a Czech (formerly Slovakian) firearms manufacturer. Development began in 2013, and the pistol was released in 2019. During this time, the company moved from Trenčín, Slovakia, to Prague, Czechia. The Alien features a low bore axis, fixed barrel, and unique non-reciprocating sights.
** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]].

=== Properties ===
==== Weapon ====
{{Feature icon|Ranged}} Strikes targets by aiming and firing at them from a distance.

{{Feature icon|Single Fire}} Fires once when the trigger is pulled. The trigger must be released before firing again.

{{Feature icon|Aim Down Sights}} Has iron sights and optical sights that significantly increase accuracy when used. 

{{Feature icon|Full Reload}} Replaces the entire magazine in one animation on reload.

{{Feature icon|Stable Accuracy|negative=true}} Suffers a significant decrease in accuracy while moving and while airborne.

==== Bullet ====
{{Feature icon|Hitscan}} Travels in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction will deviate from the crosshairs depending on accuracy.

{{Feature icon|Critical Hit}} Critically hits on headshots, applying a damage multiplier.

{{Feature icon|High Range Falloff}} Deals reduced damage when hitting targets at long distances (falloff starts beyond 30m). For the LH1, this distance is relatively far, starting at 50 meters.

{{Feature icon|Minor Structure Damage}} Damages structures. Takes a very long time to break a concrete wall.

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===
* The LH1 has a very strong headshot multiplier, dealing double the damage of a body shot.
** The LH1 can eliminate a [[Light]] contestant with two headshots, and requires one additional headshot for each step up in health class.
* The LH1 is one of the longest-ranged weapons available.

=== Weaknesses ===
* Very high bullet dispersion when hipfiring means the LH1 cannot reliably hit opponents when hipfiring, which is an issue at closer ranges.
** However, when the LH1 user is right on top of their opponent, they will still be able to easily land their shots through hipfiring.
* When the Reflector sight is installed, the LH1 has noticeable scope glint when aiming down sights, which can give away the user's location. This can be avoided by using any other sight option.

=== Tactics ===
* Firing should always be done while aiming down sights, unless the target is extremely close. Doing so greatly increases the accuracy of the LH1.
* An LH1 user should attempt to step in and out of combat to safely be able to deal damage, approaching opponents from unexpected angles so that they cannot retaliate. The moments of cover also serve to reload the weapon.

=== Hitscan ===
*When the weapon fires a shot, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs, depending on the accuracy level at the time of firing. 

*Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired.

== Trivia ==
* The LH1 exists in real life as a variant of the [[Wikipedia:Springfield_Armory_M1A|Springfield Armory M1A]], originating in the United States in 1971, which itself is based on the [[Wikipedia:M14_rifle|M14 rifle]].
** The in-game model of the weapon bears the closest resemblance to the SOCOM 16 variant of the M1A, as evidenced by the shortened barrel.
** The meaning of all of the other guns' names in ''THE FINALS'' have been found, making the LH1 the only gun where it is unknown how its name's letters relate to the model it is based on.
** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]].
* Prior to Season 6, the LH1 was the only weapon with multiple unlockable sights.

The [[SR-84]] is a [[Light]] class bolt-action [[:Category:Marksman Rifle|Sniper Rifle]] designed to deal very high damage per shot and extreme headshot damage from a long distance.

== Usage ==
The SR-84 can be selected as the [[Weapons|Weapon]] of any [[Light]] build loadout.

It has a special type of sights, offering a scope. Enabling the scope will zoom in the screen and overlay it with a duplex reticle, and will slow down movement and sensitivity. 

The trigger can be pulled to fire one bullet that damages an opponent, also dealing additional damage on headshots. The trigger must be released before firing again. Moving decreases accuracy, especially when going airborne. Firing while scoped in grants the SR-84 near-perfect accuracy, even while moving. 

The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.

The SR-84 fires hitscan bullets up to 40m. After 40m, the bullet becomes a projectile with travel time and bullet drop.

=== Properties ===
==== Weapon ====
{{Feature icon|Ranged}} Strikes targets by aiming and firing at them from a distance.

{{Feature icon|Single Fire}} Fires once when the trigger is pulled. The trigger must be released before firing again.

{{Feature icon|Scope}} Has the ability to scope in. This grants near-perfect accuracy, but produces a glint that reveals the user's location.

{{Feature icon|Full Reload}} Replaces the entire magazine in one animation on reload.

{{Feature icon|Stable Accuracy|negative=true}} Suffers a significant decrease in accuracy while moving and while airborne.

==== Bullet ====
{{Feature icon|Hitscan}} Up to 40m — Travels in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction will deviate from the crosshairs depending on accuracy.

{{Feature icon|Projectile}} After 40m — Gets affected by gravity and has a travel time.

{{Feature icon|Critical Hit}} Critically hits on headshots, applying a damage multiplier.

{{Feature icon|High Range Falloff}} Deals reduced damage when hitting targets at long distances (falloff starts beyond 30m). For the SR-84, this distance is extremely far, with the falloff starting beyond 80 meters.

{{Feature icon|Sound Cue}} Can be heard firing from across the arena. Bullets that fly near a target produce a distinct whiSR-84ing noise.

{{Feature icon|Minor Structure Damage}} Damages structures. Takes a very long time to break a concrete wall.

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===
* The SR-84 is able to reliably hit targets from extremely long distances thanks to the lack of bullet dispersion when scoped in. For shots within 40m (after which the bullet becomes a projectile) bullet drop does not need to be accounted for, as with other hitscan weapons.
* The SR-84 has a very strong headshot multiplier, dealing double the damage of a body shot.
**A [[Light]] contestant can be eliminated with a single headshot.
**A [[Medium]] contestant can be eliminated with a headshot and a body shot.
**A [[Heavy]] contestant can be eliminated with a headshot and a body shot.

* Other Useful Combos
** A [[Light]] contestant can be eliminated with a body shot and a melee.
** A [[Medium]] contestant can be eliminated with two body shots and a melee.
** A [[Medium]] contestant can be eliminated with a headshot  and a melee.
** A [[Heavy]] contestant can be eliminated with three body shots.
** A [[Heavy]] contestant can be eliminated with a headshot and three melee's.
** A [[Heavy]] contestant can be eliminated with two body shots and three melee.

=== Weaknesses ===
*The SR-84 is weak at close distances, due to its very high bullet dispersion when hipfiring, and difficulty scoping in on a close target.
* The SR-84 loses some of its damage at the absolute longest distances, meaning that hitting a target from across the arena is slightly less effective.
* The SR-84 does not have enough damage output to effectively break shields. Doing so also wastes a large part of the ammunition. However, it can be helpful to shoot the dome shield if your team is doing so as well. The SR-84, dealing 118 damage, takes off almost half of the dome shields HP of 250. That one shot can drastically reduce the time needed to shoot through a dome shield if done so in timing with your teammates attacks.
* It is not recommended to run cloak with this weapon, as the scope glint is still visible even while cloaked. 
=== Tactics ===
* An SR-84 user should continuously move to the position that best enables them to snipe the relevant opponents for the current objective. This position changes continuously, such as when opponents move through buildings or when the sniper's position is compromised. The best position is often high up, where opponents are too far away to effectively retaliate.
** The [[Grappling Hook]] can provide opportunities to quickly move from one position to the next, especially in open arenas such as [[Monaco]].
** The [[Breach Charge]] or the [[Thermal Bore]] enables the sniper to create new positional opportunities around an objective, by destroying a ceiling or wall to create a hole through which the [[Cashout Station]] can be defended.
** Some form of cover is often very helpful for when opponents retaliate. A sniper can create their own cover using a [[Goo Grenade]], allowing them to easily hide behind the wall and move out when the coast is clear.
* An alternate playstyle where the sniper is playing at moderate to close distances, often with a lot of quick-scoping, is also possible. In this case, the [[Evasive Dash]] is usually the preferred specialization.

== Trivia ==
* The SR-84 exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:Sako_85|Sako 85]] bolt-action rifle, designed by Finnish firearms manufacturer [[Wikipedia:SAKO|SAKO]] in 2006 to succeed the 1996 [[Wikipedia:Sako_75|Sako 75]]. both rifle model numbers are named after the company's 85th and 75th anniversaries respectively. 
** The "SR" in SR-84 stands for Sniper Rifle.

The trigger can be pulled to fire a grenade projectile that explodes upon impact, dealing damage to nearby opponents. The trigger must be released before firing again. The explosion also deals 1.35x more damage to its user if they are too close. The secondary trigger can be used to zoom in slightly, though this does not affect the CL-40's accuracy. Its accuracy also remains stable while moving, but decreases slightly when going airborne. The CL-40 reloads by inserting one round at a time, making its reload very slow. However, the reload can be interrupted before the magazine is full to reload fewer rounds. The reload can be cancelled by firing, using quick melee, or switching weapons. The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. {{Control scheme|weapon=Equip [[CL-40]]|primary-fire=Fire grenade (Tap)|secondary-fire=Zoom (Hold)|reload=Tactical reload}} == Stats== ===Damage Profile=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" ! rowspan="2" |

The trigger must be released before firing again. {{Feature icon|Round Reload}} Inserts a single round on reload. The next round(s) will also start reloading automatically until the magazine is full. {{Feature icon|Aim Down Sights|negative=true}} Cannot use sights. Zooms in slightly instead, but doing so does not significantly affect accuracy. {{Feature icon|Stable Accuracy|negative=true}} Keeps a stable accuracy even while moving, though going airborne specifically does decrease accuracy. ==== Projectile ==== {{Feature icon|Projectile}} Gets affected by gravity and has a travel time. {{Feature icon|Trigger on Impact}} Can fly for any amount of time and triggers when the projectile collides with a surface or contestant. {{Feature icon|Interceptible}} Can be removed by the [[APS Turret]], nullifying its effects. This causes the turret to lose some health. {{Feature icon|Critical Hit|negative=true}} Does not critically hit for increased damage, even if the target was struck on the head. {{Feature icon|High Range Falloff|negative=true}} Does not deal reduced damage when hitting targets at long distances. ==== Explosion ==== {{Feature icon|Explosive}} Deals damage in an area of effect that can be intercepted by structures and shields. {{Feature icon|Moderate Structure Damage}} Damages structures. Takes a few seconds or multiple charges to break a concrete wall. {{Feature icon|Friendly Fire|negative=true}} Can damage the user, but not their teammates. == Guide == === Strengths === * The CL-40 is one of the best Medium weapons against teams with multiple [[Light]] contestants, as it can eliminate them with two grenades and will easily strike them despite the Light class' slippery movement. * The explosions can strike multiple opponents at once if they are grouped up such as near a [[Cashout Station|cashout station]]. * The explosions deal high damage to the arena, making it very useful for quickly destroying gadgets deployed by enemies. === Weaknesses === * Reloading the CL-40's shells takes a long time, leading to long downtimes between firing. * Once a reloading animation is started, it cannot be cancelled until that shell has finished being loaded. * The CL-40's small magazine size makes missing a shot very punishing. * Since the CL-40's grenades are interceptible, the [[APS Turret]] is a direct counter to the weapon. * The user will take significant damage if they are too close to the CL-40's explosions (125 damage at point blank range) === Tactics === * The projectiles from the CL-40 can be bounced off of a [[Jump Pad]], which can be useful for shooting around a cover such as by placing it on the wall in a doorway. However, placing the Jump Pad can only be done from a short distance making it less effective as an attacking tool, and the gadget can be disposed of easily by opponents. * The CL-40 can combo with mines for extra damage and effects, taking advantage of the gun's splash damage to detonate them. [[Gas Mine|Gas Mines]] can be detonated mid-air immediately after a throw for their full effects. Due to the nuke nerfs in Season 2 however, the [[Explosive Mine]] must arm first (1.6 seconds after throw) to get its full damage, otherwise it will only deal a heavily reduced 20% damage. * While the CL-40 can destroy [[APS Turret]] placements with 3 shots in its radius, contestants should be aware of the long reload time. Having a [[Glitch Barrel]] on hand can save you some ammo in this situation. {{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the CL-40|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the CL-40|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the CL-40|xp4=20}} {{EquipmentCosmetics}} == Trivia == * The CL-40 exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:China_Lake_grenade_launcher|China Lake grenade launcher]], a pump-action grenade launcher. It was developed in 1967 at the Naval Air Weapons Station ''China Lake'', a large military installation in California, United States. The dry lake, China Lake, got its name from Chinese prospectors harvesting borax (a type of salt) from the Californian lake bed. ** The 40 in CL-40 refers to its 40mm cartridge. ** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]]. == History == {| class="wikitable" !Patch !!

One full magazine can kill any class with ease. * The XP-54 has a relatively large magazine of 34 bullets with a quick reload, making it useful for longer firefights. * The XP-54 is stronger at moderate ranges than the [[M11]] (more suited for close-range) and [[ARN-220]] (better suited for long-range) thanks to its higher accuracy, better handling and low TTK. === Weaknesses === * The XP-54's damage is worse at long ranges, compared to the [[ARN-220]]. * The XP-54 is weaker at close ranges than the comparable [[M11]] due to its lower RPM and . === Tactics === * Using the optical sights should always be done while shooting unless the opponent is extremely close, as the accuracy will be greatly increased. * An XP-54 user should attempt to step in and out of combat to safely be able to deal damage, approaching opponents from unexpected angles so that they cannot retaliate. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs, depending on the accuracy level at the time of firing. *Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan will be tagged as being struck. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired. {{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the XP-54|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source2=Critical damage dealt by the XP-54|xp2=0.2 × Critical Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the XP-54|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the XP-54|xp4=25}} {{EquipmentCosmetics}} == Trivia == * The XP-54 exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:Heckler_%26_Koch_MP5|Heckler & Koch MP5]] (Maschinenpistole 5) submachine gun developed in the 1960s by Heckler & Koch (H&K), a German firearms manufacturer. It is specifically modeled after the MP5A5, developed in the 1980s. The MP5 is one of the most widely used submachine guns in the world, having been adopted by numerous militaries, police forces, intelligence agencies and security organizations. Its successor is the [[Wikipedia:Heckler_%26_Koch_UMP|UMP]], although the MP5 remained the more successful of the two options. ** The '54' in XP-54 refers to the MP5's initial prototype designation as HK54. Under H&K's [[Wikipedia:Heckler_%26_Koch#Werknummern_designations|Werknummern]] system, the '5' categorizes it as a selective fire carbine and the '4' categorizes it as being chambered in a handgun cartridge. ** The 'XP' in XP-54 is most likely a rebranding of MP, meaning Maschinenpistole (submachine gun). ** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]]. * Prior to the [[Pre-Release#Open Beta|Open Beta]], the XP-54 had no holographic sight. == History == {| class="wikitable" !Patch !!

== Usage ==
The 93R can be selected as the [[Weapons|weapon]] of any [[Light]] build loadout.

The trigger can be pulled to fire a burst of three bullets that damage opponents, also dealing additional damage on headshots. The trigger must be released before firing again. Aiming down sights increases the 93R's accuracy. Moving decreases accuracy, especially when going airborne. 

The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.

== Guide ==
===Strengths===
* The 93R's burst fire will have the highest damage output on targets that are slow and/or large, i.e. [[Heavy|Heavies]].
* Despite a somewhat small magazine, the 93R can do a tactical reload very quickly after each engagement.

===Weaknesses===
* The 93R's damage falls off at moderate to long distances. It also becomes more difficult to hit its full burst on a target from a distance.

===Tactics===
* Firing should always be done while aiming down sights, unless the target is extremely close. Doing so greatly increases the accuracy of the 93R.
* Additionally, it's recommended to use the Compact Reflector sight, providing a clearer view aiming down sights than Iron Sights.
* A 93R user should attempt to step in and out of combat to safely be able to deal damage, approaching opponents from unexpected angles so that they cannot retaliate. The moments of cover also serve to reload the weapon.

===Hitscan===
*When the weapon fires a shot, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs, depending on the accuracy level at the time of firing. 

*Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired.

== Trivia ==
* The 93R exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:Beretta_93R|Beretta 93R]] selective-fire machine pistol, designed and manufactured by Beretta, a privately held Italian firearms manufacturing company, in the late 1970s. It was designed to be used by counter-terrorism forces as a response to the contemporary terrorism, who required a concealable weapon with rapid fire capabilities.
** The R in 93R stands for "Raffica", meaning "volley" or "burst" in Italian. 
** 93 is the model number, and the pistol is a development of the Beretta 92 design.
** The real pistol can be selected to fire either a three round burst or single fire, much like how the real [[FAMAS]] is not locked into burst mode either.
** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]].
*This weapon has received the most balance changes out of any weapon, gadget or specialization, which has led some people to call it Embark's "project gun".

[[Dual_Blades#Stats|Deflect]] | lunge = 5m | precision = 14° | environmentaldmgbar = ? }} The [[Dual Blades]] are a [[Medium]] class [[:Category:Melee|melee weapon]] designed to either deal contact damage or to use its unique ability to ricochet incoming fire in its defensive stance, which also reduces damage taken. {{Infographic|infographic-class = right|display = image|Image = Mov_m_dualblades.gif}} == Usage == The Dual Blades can be selected as the [[Weapons|weapon]] of any [[Medium]] loadout. The '''Primary Attack''' button can be used to slash opponents in front of the user and damage them. The attack button must be released before attacking again. The attacks will alternate between two quick slashes, from left to right. The '''Secondary Attack''' button can be held down to enter a defensive stance, which can be held for any duration but stops the user from sprinting. During this stance, any incoming bullets or other small projectiles will be deflected and have their damage blocked if the user has the attacking contestant within the precision zone at any range. Incoming melee damage is also reduced if the user is facing the general direction of the attacking contestant. To control the direction of the deflected projectiles while in defensive stance, the user must aim their crosshair directly at an opponent. The accuracy of these deflected projectiles depends on the accuracy with which they were fired at the user. For example, a deflected bullet from the [[SR-84]] will be very accurate, but a deflected pellet from the [[SH1900]] will not be. If the dual blades user presses their primary attack button during the defensive stance, they will perform a '''Special Attack''', dashing forward and attacking with a high-damage cross slash. This special attack costs stamina and performs a full-range lunge if the user's stamina bar is full, or performs a much shorter lunge at no cost if the user's stamina bar is not full. Hitting an enemy with the special attack will always refill the stamina bar, even if it is not a precise hit. {{Control scheme|weapon=Equip [[Dual Blades]]|primary-fire=Attack (Tap)|secondary-fire=Defensive stance (Hold)}} == Stats == *The primary attack slashes twice, with each dealing 60 damage on precise hit or 39 damage on glancing blow. *The special attack deals 155 damage on precise hit and 100 damage on glancing blow. Both the full-lunge version and the short-lunge version deal the same damage. *Deflected projectiles deal the same damage as the original attack, including range modifiers and headshots. Deflecting bullets deals 100% damage to the enemy and reduces incoming damage to 0. *Blocking a melee attack reduces its damage to 25% of the original hit. *The primary fire swings both swords. It follows an alternating pattern where both blades are swung right to left and then left to right. Each sword registers as a separate hit creating two separate attacks in one swing. The second attack in a swing happens slightly after the first one. Like all other melee attacks, the very first attack hits slightly sooner than the rest. **Timings for each individual attack are approximately: (0.47s → 0.26s) → (0.56s → 0.18s) → (0.64s → 0.26s) → (0.56s → 0.18s) → (0.64s → 0.26s) *The alternate fire raises both blades to deflect. While raised, the primary fire instead performs a lunging attack where both blades are swung at the same time. **Unlike the [[Riot Shield]], clicking while in the middle of a lunge does not buffer the input into another alternate attack, instead it buffers into a primary attack. Because of this, timings for sequential alternate attacks are more of educated guess for what perfect timing would look like. This would also mean that the more practical time to kill would be higher. **If both blades are already raised, the timings for each individual attack are approximately: 0.75s → 1.00s → 1.00s === Damage Profile === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" ! rowspan="2" |

Can attack forever without reloading. {{Feature icon|Single Fire}} Attacks once when the trigger is used. The trigger must be released before attacking again, though the next attack can be buffered. {{Feature icon|Attack Sequence}} Has a consistent pattern of attacks. {{Feature icon|Alternate Attack}} Has an alternate attack that can be held to maintain a defensive stance. {{Feature icon|Blocking}} Absorbs part of the damage from enemy attacks and deflects ranged attacks, but does not block explosive damage. {{Feature icon|Minor Structure Damage}} Damages structures. Takes a very long time to break a concrete wall. {{Feature icon|Critical Hit|negative=true}} Melee hits do not critically hit for increased damage, even if the target was struck on the head. {{Feature icon|Critical Hit}} Deflected ranged attacks critically hit on headshots and apply a damage multiplier, as long as the shot being deflected can also critically hit. == Unique Mechanics == === Block === *While blocking, incoming fire in front of the user has its damage reduced. For ranged attacks, the angle of the block must be between -14° and 14° around the crosshair, matching the precision attack cone. For melee attacks, the angle must be between -65° and 65°. If a ranged attack is successfully blocked it is reduced by 100% and deals no damage. If a melee attack is blocked it is reduced by 75% (for example, a 100 damage attack would become 25 damage). *The Dual Blades '''cannot''' block the following: [[RPG-7|RPG]], grenade launchers ([[CL-40]] and [[MGL32]]), [[grenades]], thrown [[Arena Carriables|objects]] (including [[canisters]]), mines, fire/flames, [[Winch Claw]], cannonballs, Orbital Lasers, Meteor Showers, Alien Invasion/Retro Invasion 82. *The Dual Blades '''can''' block the following: Bullets from [[Guardian Turret]], any melee damage (including the quick melee and [[Charge ‘N’ Slam|Charge 'N' Slam]]), [[Throwing Knives]], arrows from the [[Recurve Bow]]. ===Deflect=== *When a ranged attack is blocked, it will be deflected towards the player's crosshair. All blocked ranged attacks are also deflected. *When deflecting a hitscan weapon, the deflected projectile will also be a hitscan. When deflecting a projectile weapon like the [[Recurve Bow]], [[Throwing Knives]] or [[KS-23]], the deflected projectile will retain the same speed and bullet drop characteristics of the original projectile. *The damage of the deflected shot matches that of the gunshot being deflected as if the dual blades user had shot it themselves. Range and headshot multipliers apply. ===Hit Registration=== * As of Season 12, the blocking angle is calculated entirely server-side, but if a ranged attack is successfully deflected it is calculated and confirmed normally as if it were shot by the deflecting player (ie. client-side unless at high ping). Effectively, deflected shots are aimed as if the Dual Blades user themselves had shot them, but the block that engages those deflected shots may fail to register even with perfect aim because of server-client aim desync. This worsens with higher ping and faster moving targets due to the small size of the Dual Blades' blocking/deflection cone. *The block/deflect registration is at its most inconsistent when a target is moving fast relative to screen-space (ie. how fast they are moving across the Dual Blades player's screen), or when moving laterally together with an opponent at close range (ie. both players looking at each other and strafing the same direction). Given the aforementioned small block/deflect angle and server-side block registration, these scenarios in particular will cause a very high number of missed blocks/deflects. Other players moving fast enough or at close enough range effectively outpace even perfectly tracked blocks due to the time it takes for the server to catch up to where the Dual Blades user's aim actually is. *Since projectiles are fired from around the head area on other clients (where a player's camera is positioned), a dual blades user engaging targets at closer range may also find that they have to aim higher towards enemy contestants' heads in order to successfully block shots. == Guide == === Strengths === * The Dual Blades are strong in close-quarters combat. * The Dual Blades' defensive stance can be used while moving towards an opponent to close the gap. * The Dual Blades can block incoming fire from long range, and even deflect it back at other contestants. * The Dual Blades' defensive stance offers a significant damage reduction against melee attacks in addition to ranged attacks. === Weaknesses === * The Dual Blades' defensive stance is easily countered if the user is attacked by multiple opponents that are not attacking from the same direction. If a Dual Blades user is blocking and walking up to an opponent in one direction, another opponent can assist by going around the Dual Blades user and attacking them from the side. * Explosions and fire are not blocked by the defensive stance. === Tactics === * To approach an opponent with a ranged weapon, a Dual Blades user can walk up to them while using the defensive stance similarly to the [[Riot Shield]]. Once close enough and they stop firing to run away or to reload, the user should switch to the melee attack to deal heavy damage and move quickly. * Dual Blades can excel with good movement. Shockwave can be a fantastic choice for gap-closing if the Dual Blades user propels themselves with it towards the enemy. The special attack can also spend the user's stamina to force a full-distance lunge, even with no enemy in range of the precision attack cone. Both can be used in combination with Jump Pads or other gadgets to cross large distances quickly and close in for melee eliminations. * Player momentum can be carried into the defensive stance to move faster while blocking, even if sprint cannot be used while it is up. To use the momentum from a [[Jump Pad]], Launch Pad or [[Speed Tunnel]] before slowing down, a couple of short hops can be used while the defensive stance is up. Additionally, if a sprint is engaged before putting up the defensive stance, a slide can be engaged while blocking if the Dual Blades user still has enough momentum. * Due to the small blocking area for ranged attacks, a dual blades user should always try to single out targets or force enemy players to group up tightly using terrain or other methods. Engaging spread out groups without proper planning can be a death sentence if the attention of more than one enemy is caught. * To counteract the server-side block registration behavior while it is an issue, a Dual Blades user should keep other players at a distance and only close in when they know there's an advantage that could be taken by a non-blocking melee player. When forced into close-range high-movement scenarios (at around 5-7m), the Dual Blades user will also have to aim ahead of the opponent if they are trying to block, predicting the opponent's movement based on their own estimated ping. In such scenarios, it is better to accept that no deflections will land due to how far out of sync the client and server is at that point, and to try to keep the crosshair towards where the other player is moving towards. (Note that it is possible to see where the server thinks the client's aim is by watching where the bullet trails are landing. While the shots do register at the crosshair, the trails can give information on how far off the server and client aim actually are. If the trails manage to connect with the opposing player, it will register as a hit. An example can be seen with the old behavior below, which is still technically present in the game.) {| |[[File:Dualblades hitregistration 20-30ms.gif|frame|left|alt=The crosshair is seen roughly moving along with a target dummy, with reflected shots trailing behind the crosshair. Despite the crosshair staying relatively on target, not a single hitmarker can be seen.|An example of the deflect's old hit registration behavior at low ping (20-30ms). This shows server-client aim desync, an issue that still affects the blocking component of the Dual Blades. This is still technically present in the game, just now with an additional client-side hit trace so the shots will actually hit. In the current version, if the bullet trails and the crosshair get too far apart due to desync (usually at close range or high speed) the block will not register.]] |} {{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the Dual Blades|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the Dual Blades|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the Dual Blades|xp4=20}} {{EquipmentCosmetics}} == Gallery == {{#ev:youtube|SQHIHUekA60|350|inline|Dual Blades Deflect vs EVERYTHING - Jinko}} == History == {| class="wikitable" !Patch !!

The [[M26 Matter]] is a [[Light]] class bolt-action [[:Category:Shotgun|Shotgun]] that is magazine fed, designed to deal high damage at close range. 
{{Infographic|infographic-class = right|display = image

== Usage ==
The M26 Matter can be selected as the [[Weapons|Weapon]] of any [[Light]] build loadout.

The trigger can be pulled to fire a spread of pellets that each deal a small amount of damage. Like all shotguns, the weapon does not deal additional damage on headshots and aiming down sights does not decrease the M26 Matter's pellet spread, but the weapon keeps a stable accuracy when moving and going airborne.

The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.

=== Properties ===
==== Weapon ====
{{Feature icon|Ranged}} Strikes targets by aiming and firing at them from a distance.

{{Feature icon|Single Fire}} Fires once when the trigger is pulled. The trigger must be released before firing again. 

{{Feature icon|Multi-Shot}} Releases multiple rounds at the same time with each shot, each dealing minor damage.

{{Feature icon|Stable Accuracy}} Keeps a stable accuracy (pellet spread), even while moving and going airborne. 

{{Feature icon|Full Reload}} Replaces the entire magazine in one animation on reload.

{{Feature icon|Aim Down Sights|negative=true}} Has iron sights, but using them does not affect accuracy (pellet spread).

==== Bullet ====
{{Feature icon|Hitscan}} Travels in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction will deviate from the crosshairs depending on accuracy.

{{Feature icon|Minor Structure Damage}} Damages structures. Takes a very long time to break a concrete wall.

{{Feature icon|Critical Hit|negative=true}} Does not critically hit for increased damage, even if the target was struck on the head. 

== Guide==
[[File:M26_10m.png|thumb|right|300px|<center>10m Spread pattern</center>]]
===Strengths===
*The M26 Matter stays accurate even while moving or jumping, which helps when you're on the move in a fight.
*It does high damage up close, making it strong in close-range battles.
*The shotgun is great for tight spaces, where close-range combat is most common.

===Weaknesses===
*The shotgun works best up close, and it’s not as effective at medium or long range.
*It doesn’t do extra damage for headshots, so you rely on hitting your target with the spread of pellets.
*Aiming down sights doesn’t make shots more accurate, reducing damage at range.

===Tactics===
*The M26 Matter is best used at closer ranges, try to find tight areas like hallways to maintain close range. 
*Keep moving during fights, as the weapon stays accurate while you're on the move.
*Aim for the center of your enemies when they're close to make sure most pellets hit for maximum damage.
*A quick melee can be used to optimize time to kill on a medium opponent.
*This weapon's high damage makes it effective for hit-and-run tactics, try to play around cover between shots.

{{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the 93R|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the 93R|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the 93R|xp4=20}}
{{EquipmentCosmetics}}

==Trivia==
*The M26 Matter exists in real life as the [[wikipedia:M26_Modular_Accessory_Shotgun_System|M26 Modular Accessory Shotgun System]], a lightweight shotgun system meant to be mounted as an underbarrel attachment to an m4 or m16 series rifle. the Matter in game is featured as a standalone configuration featuring an extended barrel (likely 18 inch) which does not appear to have a real life counterpart.
**Contrary to the in-game description the M26 is not pump action, but rather straight-pull bolt action, as it features a bolt handle mounted directly to the bolt carrier group rather than a pump handle placed on the forestock. Another example of a weapon featuring this action in a more conventional design is the [[Wikipedia:K31|Swiss K31]]

*The name "Matter" is a play on the real life designation which abbreviates to "MASS". However, unlike the real title, the in-game name does not appear to refer to an acronym.

== Usage ==
The CB-01 Repeater can be selected as the weapon for any [[Medium]] build loadout.

The trigger can be pulled to fire a single shot that damages an opponent, dealing additional damage on headshots. Aiming down sights increases the weapon's accuracy, but moving decreases it, especially when airborne.

If the weapon is reloaded before the magazine is fully emptied (a tactical reload), it uses a segmented reload, loading one bullet at a time. This process can be interrupted by firing at any point.

If the magazine is fully emptied, the weapon automatically performs a faster reload using a speed loader that quickly inserts most of the magazine. After this, the segmented reload resumes to top off remaining bullets. Firing during this process cancels the reload once the speed loader has been used.{{Control scheme|weapon=Equip [[CB-01 Repeater]]|primary-fire=Fire shot <small>(Tap)</small>|secondary-fire=Aim down sights <small>(Hold)</small>|reload=Tactical reload}}

=== Properties ===
==== Weapon ====
{{Feature icon|Ranged}} Strikes targets by aiming and firing at them from a distance.

{{Feature icon|Single Fire}} Fires once when the trigger is pulled. The trigger must be released before firing again.

{{Feature icon|Aim Down Sights}} Has iron sights and optical sights that significantly increase accuracy when used.

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===

* Excels at dealing high damage per bullet, especially on headshots.
** Repeatedly landing headshots results in a very fast time-to-kill against all three [[Builds]].
* Good overall range and damage falloff, allowing it to stay competitive across longer distances.
* Can immediately cancel segmented reloads, allowing you to potentially fire the weapon in a pinch with just 1-2 shots reloaded.

=== Weaknesses ===

* Low magazine size and lengthy reloads, especially when fully reloading the magazine.
** This makes running out of ammunition during ongoing gunfights punishing.
* Vulnerable in close ranges due to its single-shot nature and mediocre hipfire accuracy.
* Requires good accuracy and positioning.
** The weapon's overall slow rate-of-fire makes most missed shots punishing, especially when the user is actively being pressured by other contestants.

=== Tactics ===

* The weapon excels at locking down open areas.
** Positioning yourself on higher ground to overlook a common choke point or travel route can result in easy damage.
* Intentionally slowing down your aim and firing speed to line up headshots can be powerful.
** This allows you to quickly cause high burst damage, which can be valuable, especially if your teammates are nearby to follow-up on said damage.

=== Recoil ===

No significant recoil pattern.

* The CB-01 Repeater has noticeable visual kick when fired, but your crosshair returns to its original position before the weapon can fire again.
* Focus on tracking your tracking your target between shots, as accuracy relies more on aim adjustment than recoil control.

== Trivia ==
*The Chimera-XB is a semi-automatic compound crossbow which does not seem to be based on any known design. While designs for [[wikipedia:Repeating_crossbow|repeating crossbows]] date back to 4th Century BC, no functioning mechanism currently exists for an automatic crossbow which would not require the user to manually draw the string between shots. Because of this, the Chimera's design and animations take various physical liberties to present a mechanism which seems plausible at a glance, but could not function in reality.
**The Chimera features two sets of reciprocating limbs which alternate positions on each shot. Presumably, when one set fires, the same momentum which launches the bolt also draws the other set to its ready position. This function violates the first and second laws of [[wikipedia:Thermodynamics|thermodynamics]] as well as the law  of [[wikipedia:Conservation_of_energy|conservation of energy]], and therefore classes the Chimera as a [[wikipedia:Perpetual_motion|perpetual motion machine of the first kind]].
**Upon a reload or empty magazine, the engaged set of limbs discharge to the unready position without charging the other set of limbs to the ready position, which does not break any physical laws but is internally inconsistent to how the weapon functions under normal firing conditions.
**The "charging handle" that is pulled by the contestant after a reload does not seem to have any physical connection to the cable it draws when pulled.
**Because each set of cables sits at two different heights but must draw from one magazine, the top cable is not vertically aligned with the bolt and must stretch downward at the trigger. For a real crossbow, this misalignment would result in a misfire as the rear of the bolt is flung upward rather than launched down range.
*Because of the weapon's impossible nature, the name "Chimera" may be in reference to a 1494 quote by [[wikipedia:Leonardo_da_Vinci|Leonardo Da Vinci]] in passage from his notebooks which reads:
**''"O speculators about '''perpetual motion''', how many vain '''chimeras''' have you created in the like quest? Go and take your place with the seekers after gold."'' 
***This quote mocked the futility of those attempting to discover true perpetual motion, labeling their attempts as ''"Vain Chimeras"'' despite Da Vinci having himself made many attempts at his own designs for a perpetual motion machine. ''"take your place with the seekers after gold"'' referred to the pseudoscientific practice of [[wikipedia:Alchemy|Alchemy]] which claimed that common metals such as lead could be turned into noble metals such as gold through a process known as "Alchemical Transmutation."
**The designation "XB" is a relatively uncommon shortening of "Crossbow" where the "X" is interpreted as a cross rather than standing for a word that starts with the letter X.

The '''R .357''' ''(Taurus Raging Bull '''R'''evolver .'''357''' Magnum)'' is a [[Medium]] class [[:Category:Handgun|revolver]] designed to deal high damage per shot and very high headshot damage at close to moderate distances.

== Usage ==
The R .357 can be selected as the [[Weapons|weapon]] of any [[Medium]] build loadout.

The trigger can be pulled to fire one bullet that damages an opponent, also dealing additional damage on headshots. The trigger must be released before firing again. Aiming down sights increases the R .357's accuracy. Moving decreases accuracy, especially when going airborne. 

The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===
* The R .357 has a very strong headshot multiplier, dealing double the damage of a body shot.
** Landing a headshot on a [[Light]] contestant leaves them with 23 hp.

=== Weaknesses ===
* The R .357's small magazine size makes missing a shot very punishing.
* The R .357's damage falls off severely at moderate to long distances.
* The iron sights on the R .357 offer limited visibility, but using them is mandatory to have any accuracy.

=== Tactics ===
* The R .357 has strong hipfire accuracy at close range, but aiming down sight is recommended for longer-range engagements.
* The magazine of the R .357 should be topped up whenever possible. One bullet missing in the magazine could mean the difference between winning or losing an engagement.

=== Hitscan ===
*When the weapon fires a shot, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs, depending on the accuracy level at the time of firing. 

*Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired.

** The "R" in R .357 stands for "Revolver".

The [[Model 1887]] ''(Winchester '''Model 1887''')'', or M1887, or just simply Model for short, is a [[Medium]] class lever-action [[:Category:Shotgun|shotgun]] designed to deal high damage per shot in a wide pellet spread at a close distance.

== Usage ==

The Model 1887 reloads by inserting one round at a time, making its reload extremely slow. However, the reload can be interrupted before the magazine is full to reload less rounds.

The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===
* The Model 1887's accuracy is mostly unaffected by moving, and does not need to aim down sights to attain maximum accuracy. This makes it possible to strafe around an opponent while hip-firing at them, all while maintaining high accuracy.
* The Model 1887 (as well as the [[CL-40]]) can be highly effective in matches with multiple [[Light]] build contestants, as the Model 1887 will eliminate a Light contestant in two shots, even if neither shot is fully accurate.
* Hitting all pellets on an enemy will deal 117 damage, meaning a Medium opponent can be killed in only 3 hits.

=== Weaknesses ===
* Reloading the Model 1887's shells takes a long time, leading to long downtimes between firing.
* Once a reloading animation is started, it cannot be cancelled until that shell has finished being loaded.
* High pellet dispersion means that enemies that are not close to the user will not take much damage from a shot.
* An undamaged [[Heavy]] contestant may mean trouble for a Model 1887 user, as they take several slow shots to take down.

=== Tactics ===
* The magazine of the Model 1887 should be full whenever possible. One shell missing in the magazine could mean the difference between winning or losing an engagement.
* Due to the Model 1887's reloading mechanics, where two shells can be inserted at the same time depending on the magazine state, doing a tactical reload after firing 3 out of 6 shells is the most efficient. If the Model 1887 user chooses to go for full reloads instead, they will have relatively more downtime.
* Using the 1887 to poke enemies at medium to long range can be surprisingly effective. Dealing small amounts of damage will slowly whittle down the opponent's health pool while also resetting their health regen timer.


[[File:Model1887_10m.png|thumb|right|300px|<center>10m Spread pattern</center>]]

=== Hitscan ===
*For each pellet in a shot fired by the weapon, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs for each pellet. Since the shotgun has a fixed low accuracy, the random deviation of the pellets causes them to spread out into a fan. 

*Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan of each pellet will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired.

In this state, ranged attacks coming from the left of the user will still be blocked if they hit the shield. * Similarly to the [[Dual Blades]], a Riot Shield user can walk up to their target while blocking, then attack when they are close enough and the opponent is reloading or trying to escape, or when the baton would outdamage them. * The Riot Shield is able to fully absorb the damage from explosions when positioned correctly. * The Riot Shield is able to negate the effects of the [[Flashbang]] when positioned correctly, allowing the user to throw them at their feet and confront opponents without getting blinded. * Similarly to [[Shockwave]], the Riot Shield's Shield Bash can be used to knockback opponents and push them out of the interaction range of objectives, interrupting any channeling actions like stealing from a [[Cashout Station]]. The knockback itself does not interrupt any channeling actions. === Block === *Unlike the [[Dual Blades]], which block damage based on the direction of the incoming attack, the Riot Shield uses a solid surface positioned at the Riot Shield's model that blocks ranged attacks specifically. It can also block explosion damage, if positioned as a surface between the user and the explosion source. *[[Flamethrower]] projectiles are blocked, but they will still set the user on fire to deal damage over time. === Bash === {{Stub}} {{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the Riot Shield|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source2=Critical damage dealt by the Riot Shield|xp2=0.2 × Critical Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the Riot Shield|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the Riot Shield|xp4=20}} {{EquipmentCosmetics}} == Trivia == * The Riot Shield is modeled after the real-life [[Wikipedia:Riot_shield|riot shield]] and [[Wikipedia:Baton_(law_enforcement)|police baton]]. == History == {| class="wikitable" !Patch !!

Also, it is not possible to quickly replenish one missing shell like with the [[CL-40]]. * Unlike the [[CL-40]], the MGL32 struggles to reliably hit nearby opponents when there is no wall or ceiling nearby, due to the forced bounce before detonating. ** When facing an MGL32 user, getting very close to them is often a death sentence for the MGL32 user, as the target becomes very difficult to hit. Additionally, close hits lead to the MGL32 user taking damage from their own grenades. ** Having the high ground over an MGL32 user (with no ceiling overhead) is also a counter to them, such as when peeking through a hole in the ceiling over the MGL32 user. * Arenas where a lot of the fighting occurs in wide open areas, such as [[Seoul]], offer poor conditions for the MGL32, as there will often not be a nearby surface to reliably bounce grenades off of. ** Arenas with slanted roofs—[[Monaco]] and [[Skyway Stadium]]—also offer poor conditions for the MGL32 while fighting on them, as it is impossible to reliably hit the grenades off of the slanted surfaces. * When the area is largely covered in rubble, such as from a [[Sledgehammer]] user or from a collapsed suspended structure with the [[Cashout Station|cashout station]] on it, the MGL32 struggles to reliably bounce its grenades towards opponents due to the irregularly slanted surfaces. * Since the MGL32's grenades are interceptible, the [[APS Turret]] is a counter to the weapon. It will nullify a few of the MGL32's grenades. * The MGL32 has trouble hitting far-away targets, especially when the target is at a higher altitude, due to the arc trajectory and slowness of its projectiles. === Tactics === * When facing an opponent directly in line of sight under a low ceiling, it is possible to fire at the ceiling such that the grenades will quickly detonate on the ground below. Some experience is required to predict the bounce correctly. ** This is especially effective when taking cover behind a [[Barricade]], as the user cannot be hit by incoming fire while still having access to the ceiling to bounce grenades off of. * An MGL32 user should try to bring the fight to an area where the conditions are right for them. For example, when fighting in a residential area in [[Monaco]], the user should lead their opponents into the buildings, rather than fighting on the streets or on the rooftops. * An [[APS Turret]] can be removed by utilizing the MGL32's splash damage. The grenade needs to detonate right outside of the turret's effective range to damage it. * [[Charge 'N' Slam]] can be a good choice to deal with opponents that get too close to damage them with the MGL32. {{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the MGL32|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the MGL32|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the MGL32|xp4=20}} {{EquipmentCosmetics}} == Trivia == * The MGL32 exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:Milkor_MGL|Milkor MGL]], a lightweight grenade launcher with a six-shot revolver-style magazine. It was developed by Milkor (Pty) Ltd., a South African arms company, in 1981 and introduced in 1983. ** The MGL32 is named after the M32 MGL (Model 32 Multi-shot Grenade Launcher). [[Evasive Dash]] is a [[Light]] class specialization that allows its user to perform a dash frequently, which rapidly moves them a small distance in any direction.
{{Infographic | infographic-class = right | display = image
 | Image = Mov_l_evasivedash.gif
}} 
== Usage ==

Evasive Dash can be selected as the [[Specializations|Specialization]] gadget of any [[Light]] build loadout.

The specialization trigger can be used to perform a dash. The direction of the dash depends on the direction in which its user is attempting to move. For example, if the movement trigger is set to move to the left while activating Evasive Dash, it will perform a dash to the left.

The vertical direction of the dash depends on the looking direction of the user. If the user is looking upwards, the dash will move up. However, Evasive Dash is primarily a horizontal movement tool and cannot go straight up or down.
{{Control scheme|specialization=Dash <small>(Tap)</small>}}
== Stats ==
=== Effects ===
Evasive Dash can be activated to dash a short distance, going in a direction based on the user's movement inputs and their looking direction. Uniquely, using this specialization does not interrupt actions such as drawing the [[Recurve Bow]], holding a [[Sword]] lunge or scoping in with the [[SR-84]].

=== Properties ===
==== Gadget ====
{{Feature icon|Self Targeted}} Can be activated to apply an effect to the contestant that used it.

{{Feature icon|Multiple Charges}} Can be used 3 times. When a charge is used, it automatically recharges over the cooldown time.

{{Feature icon|Disarms User|negative=true}} Does not stop the user from using their other items while the gadget is active. The user can act while dashing, or even dash in the middle of an action.

==== Dash ====
{{Feature icon|Movement}} Provides a special mode of transport for contestants.

== Guide ==
=== Strengths ===
* The Evasive Dash can be used to quickly close the gap to reach an opponent, as many [[Light]] weapons rely on getting close to the target.
** The Evasive Dash also helps with getting away, another important feature for Light contestants who do not have much health.
* The Evasive Dash can be used to take cover, such as by dashing sideways or backwards into an opening.

=== Weaknesses ===
* The [[Nullifier]] can make an Evasive Dash user unable to use it.
* The Evasive Dash has limited usefulness in wide open areas, where dashing behind cover is not possible.
* Using Evasive Dash carelessly could result in dashing into a trap such as an [[Explosive Mine]].

=== Tactics ===
* The Evasive Dash synergizes well with the [[Throwing Knives]], as the weapon's accuracy is not affected by intense movement.
* The Evasive Dash can be combined with the [[Sword]]'s lunge ability to extend its range.

{{EquipmentMastery|source1=Activating Evasive Dash|xp1=20}}

Max - 29s | costs= 33% of energy }} [[File:Mov_l_cloakingdevice.gif|right]] The [[Cloaking Device]] is a [[Light]] class specialization that allows its user to enter invisibility for a limited duration. == Usage == The Cloaking Device can be selected as the [[Specializations|specialization]] gadget of any [[Light]] build loadout. The specialization trigger can be used to toggle on the gadget. It will remain active for up to 12 seconds, after which it is automatically disabled to recharge. It can also be disabled before this point by toggling it again. Attacking or using an item will forcibly end the effect. Energy consumption is largely based on speed; crouching will lower energy consumption, sprinting will increase it. {{Control scheme|specialization=Toggle on/off (Tap)}} == Stats == === Effects === The Cloaking Device can be activated to grant its user temporary invisibility. Opponents will not be able to see the user well, although there are still indications that the user is present: * A glitchy visual effect replaces the contestant's body. This effect is almost completely invisible while the user is standing still, but very noticeable if the user is moving. * A glitchy sound is produced when you; activate cloak, move while cloaked, or the cloak is deactivated. This can be heard by enemies up to 30m away. === Energy-Based Cooldown === The Cloaking Device consumes energy based on the user’s movement speed while cloaked, remaining motionless consumes the least amount of energy, enabling the user to stay cloaked for a maximum of 27 seconds in a single charge. The Cloaking Device’s invisibility will not be disrupted by burning or poison damage. === Properties === ==== Gadget ==== {{Feature icon|Self Targeted}} Can be activated to apply an effect to the contestant that used it. {{Feature icon|Toggle}} Can be enabled and disabled by reactivating. {{Feature icon|Battery Charge}} Uses up charge while used. Recharges over time. {{Feature icon|Single Charge}} Can be used once, then recharges automatically over the cooldown time. {{Feature icon|Disarms User}} Forces the user to stop using their other items, as doing so will cancel the Cloaking Device. ==== Effect ==== {{Feature icon|Sound Cue}} Produces a glitched noise while moving, alerting nearby contestants of the user's presence. {{Feature icon|Visibility}} Affects the line of sight of the user and/or opponents. Opponents are unable to see the user well. == Guide == === Strengths === * Standing still while cloaked will make the user nearly undetectable, even to opponents who are walking directly past the user. The user still has collision which could give them away if an opponent bumps into them. === Weaknesses === * [[Thermal Vision]] hard counters the Cloaking Device as it can also reveal the heat signature of a cloaked player. * Detection sources such as the [[Motion Sensor]] and [[Sonar Grenade]] can still reveal the location of a cloaked enemy. * When you activate or deactivate the Cloaking Device, it makes a distinct sound that can be heard from up to 30m away. * Moving while cloaked makes a loud distinct sound which can also be heard from up to 30m away. * Taking damage will cause a cloaked player to instantly decloak. * Activating cloak consumes 33% of your overall meter, punishing repeated uses. === Tactics === * Remaining in a motionless state while cloaked will make it nearly impossible for enemies to see and hear you and consume less cloak meter. * Activating Cloaking Device while cloaked from a [[Vanishing Bomb]] allows the contestant to seamlessly transition to the other invisibility, effectively extending it. There will be a subtle visual cue when activating the cloaking device this way. * Mantling an object in a motionless state by tapping the forward and jump buttons at the same time will retain the motionless state properties, allowing you to move slightly while still being extremely difficult to see and hear and consuming the least amount of cloak meter. * Utilize loud sound effects from the arena, or setup your own with [[Breach Charge]], [[Gravity Vortex]], or [[Thermal Bore]] to mask your cloak activation sound and/or movement sounds. {{EquipmentMastery |source1 = Activating the Cloaking Device |xp1 = 30 }} == History == {| class="wikitable" !Patch !!

Doing so greatly increases the accuracy of the FCAR. === Recoil === [[File:Fcar_recoil.png|400px|right]] How to control: # Pull straight down on the first four bullets # After the 4th bullet, pull hard down and to the left # After the 7th bullet, pull straight down again # Pull down and left slightly during the 11th to 19th bullet # Pull down slightly until the mag is empty === Hitscan === *When the weapon fires a shot, a target is scanned for using a hitscan. This is a detection mechanism that scans in a straight line, meaning there is no bullet drop. The direction of this line will be deviate randomly from the direction of the crosshairs, depending on the accuracy level at the time of firing. *Immediately, the closest contestant, structure, object or shield intersecting the hitscan will be tagged as being struck. First, a bullet tracer animation quickly travels from the weapon to the hit location, then its effects are applied. This means it is possible for targets to be struck a few frames after they appear to take cover, as the hit is confirmed the moment the weapon is fired. {{EquipmentMastery|source1=Damage dealt by the FCAR|xp1=0.2 × Damage Dealt|source2=Critical damage dealt by the FCAR|xp2=0.2 × Critical Damage Dealt|source3=Opponent eliminated by the FCAR|xp3=50|source4=Assist on an opponent damaged by the FCAR|xp4=20}} {{EquipmentCosmetics}} == Trivia == * Prior to the [[Open Beta]], the FCAR had no holographic sight. * The FCAR exists in real life as the [[Wikipedia:FN_SCAR|FN SCAR]], an automatic rifle developed by FN Herstal, a leading firearms manufacturer based in Herstal, Belgium. The FCAR is specifically modeled after the SCAR-H battle rifle variant. The weapon came out on top in the 2004 SOCOM solicitation held by the United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM), leading to the FN SCAR becoming the standard weapon for the USSOCOM. The weapon is one of the most recognizable battle rifles in existence, being used by numerous militaries and police forces around the world. Most notably, it has been employed by the United States Army in many operations including the Iraq war and the Russo-Ukrainian war. ** The "F" in FCAR (and "FN" in "FN SCAR") stands for "FN Herstal", the manufacturer. ** The "CAR" in FCAR stands for "Combat Assault Rifle". ** The "S" in the original name "FN SCAR", means "Special Operations Forces" (US), the weapon's main user. ** See also: [[List of Gun Origins]]. * In version 2.2.0, the damage coefficient is 0.55 instead of 0.5. * The music track that plays during the special inspect animation for the Disciple of Sound mythic skin for the FCAR changes after an empty reload and restarts after a tactical reload, which correlates with the reload animations depicting the contestant switching out the CD during an empty reload and rewinding the track during a tactical reload. == History == {| class="wikitable" !Patch !!

The [[KS-23]] ''('''K'''arabin '''S'''petsialniy '''23'''mm)'' is a [[Heavy]] class slug [[:Category:Shotgun|shotgun]] designed to deal high damage per slug at close to moderate distances, also dealing significant damage to structures.

== Usage ==
The KS-23 can be selected as the [[Weapons|weapon]] of any [[Heavy]] build loadout.

The trigger can be pulled to fire one projectile that damages an opponent. The weapon does not deal additional damage on headshots but deals significant structure damage. The trigger must be released before firing again. Zooming in with the secondary trigger slightly increases the KS-23's accuracy. Moving decreases accuracy.

The KS-23 reloads by inserting one round at a time, making its reload extremely slow. However, the reload can be interrupted before the magazine is full to reload less rounds. 

The weapon automatically reloads when its magazine is empty, or the user can do a tactical reload before this point. The user has unlimited spare ammunition.
